about.body1: I'm a registered nurse with over 15 years of NHS and private healthcare experience, and the founder of Cottage Aesthetics. My background in plastic surgery, dermatology and reconstructive services at a world leading hospital has taught me that every face is unique and that the best results come from understanding the individual in front of me.
about.body2: I believe great care is about more than the treatment itself: Trust, honesty and safety are at the heart of every appointment. My goal is simply to help you look and feel like the best version of yourself, never changing who you are, just enhancing what makes you, *you*.
about.title: Hello, I'm Purdi
